session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update({
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['API_TOKEN']}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
})

# Compare neighborhoods using their growth and demand metrics.
comparison_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/neighborhood/comparison",
    json={
        "neighborhoods": [
            {"name": "Neighborhood A", "growth_metrics": {}, "demand_metrics": {}},
            {"name": "Neighborhood B", "growth_metrics": {}, "demand_metrics": {}},
        ]
    },
)
comparison_response.raise_for_status()
comparison = comparison_response.json()

# Select the highest-ranked neighborhood when the response provides rankings.
rankings = comparison.get("rankings") or comparison.get("neighborhoods") or []
selected_neighborhood = (
    max(rankings, key=lambda item: item.get("score", item.get("suitability_score", 0)))
    if rankings
    else {"name": "Neighborhood A"}
)

# Create a property listing in the selected neighborhood.
property_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/properties",
    json={
        "name": "New Investment Property",
        "neighborhood": selected_neighborhood.get("name", "Neighborhood A"),
        "address": "123 Example Street",
        "property_type": "residential",
        "price": 0,
        "description": "New property investment listing.",
    },
)
property_response.raise_for_status()
property_data = property_response.json()
property_id = property_data.get("property_id", property_data.get("id"))
if property_id is None:
    raise ValueError("Property creation response did not include a property ID.")

# Submit the tenant's rental history for verification.
tenant_id = os.environ["TENANT_ID"]
history_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/tenant/rental-history",
    json={
        "tenantId": tenant_id,
        "propertyId": property_id,
        "rental_history": os.environ.get("TENANT_RENTAL_HISTORY", ""),
    },
)
history_response.raise_for_status()
rental_history = history_response.json()

# Attach the rental history data to the property listing as a document.
document_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/properties/{property_id}/documents",
    json={
        "document_type": "tenant_rental_history",
        "tenantId": tenant_id,
        "rental_history": rental_history,
    },
)
document_response.raise_for_status()
document_data = document_response.json()

# Delete the unwanted property document.
document_id = os.environ.get("UNWANTED_DOCUMENT_ID") or document_data.get(
    "document_id", document_data.get("id")
)
if document_id is None:
    raise ValueError("No document ID was provided or returned.")

delete_response = session.delete(
    f"{BASE_URL}/properties/{property_id}/documents/{document_id}"
)
delete_response.raise_for_status()
